headline: Enhancing ClearInstall with Public Trend Signals
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis and risk assessment tools to improve ClearInstall's local-first lockfile auditing. Leverage advanced agent-based monitoring for enhanced security checks during installation, and incorporate machine learning models for predictive analytics on potential vulnerabilities.
actions: Integrate Minireel/HGhub’s real-time dependency analysis capabilities to provide up-to-date information on package versions and their associated risks.
